title: Encouraging Younger Singaporeans to Take Up Trade Jobs such as Licensed Electricians and Plumbers
what_it_is: Encouraging Younger Singaporeans to Take Up Trade Jobs such as Licensed Electricians and Plumbers

sections.label: Encouraging younger Singaporeans into trade jobs
sections.summary: The Minister was asked whether the Ministry is exploring strategies to encourage younger Singaporeans into trade jobs and whether a larger Singapore Core can be built in such jobs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry is looking into new strategies to encourage younger Singaporeans to take up trade jobs, such as licensed electricians and plumbers, amongst others; and (b) whether it is the Ministry’s assessment that a larger Singapore Core can be built up in such jobs in the short to medium term.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: It would not be realistic to aim to grow the Singapore Core in every single occupation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: As all Members are aware, our local workforce is finite, with the ageing cohorts larger than the cohorts that are entering the workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Through the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs), sector agencies have worked with industry to map out growth plans for 23 sectors across the entire economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: To complement these ITMs, MOM launched Jobs Transformation Maps (JTMs) in 2021.

sections.label: Resident workers in PMET jobs
sections.summary: From 2011 to 2021, the share of resident workers in PMET jobs rose from 52.7% to 62.1%, while non-PMET jobs declined in share.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: From 2011 to 2021, the proportion of resident workers in Professional, Managerial, Executive and Technician (PMET) jobs rose from 52.7% to 62.1%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Non-PMET jobs, which would include some of the trade jobs that the Member talked about, declined in share.

sections.label: Younger resident workers in PMET jobs
sections.summary: A higher proportion of resident workers aged 25 to 29 were in PMET jobs in 2021, and the Government will work with industry and tripartite partners on job opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: A higher proportion of resident workers aged 25 to 29 are in PMET jobs – 75.5% in 2021, compared to 67% in 2011.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to work closely with industry and tripartite partners to create a wide range of job opportunities and prepare our workers for jobs that are in demand.
